description: This Java class defines a Subscriber actor for a pub/sub system, distributing messages to local subscribers based on message topics, and tracking true/false positives with metrics counters.

classes.name: Subscriber
classes.description: An actor class that distributes messages to local subscribers based on message topics and maintains metrics counters for message distribution accuracy.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for Actor system with message class and topic extractor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for the actor, matching message class and subscription updates.

methods.name: broadcastToLocalSubscribers
methods.description: Sends message to local subscribers based on extracted topics, updates true/false positive counters.

methods.name: updateLocalSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates the actor's local subscription list.
